In October 2018 our record concentrated on one confirmation. On October 6, forty-two of us said "the supreme court," thirty-two said "brett kavanaugh to," thirty-one said "to the supreme court," and twenty-seven said "judge brett kavanaugh." That same day, twenty-four of us said "of sexual assault." Four of our most-repeated phrases peaked together on October 6, around the same subject; the convergence was single-day.

Later, on October 27, twenty-seven of us said "tree of life."

Two smaller currents ran beneath the confirmation. On October 10, twenty-three of us said "army corps of engineers." On October 3, twenty-two of us said "aviation administration faa."

We record that our attention that month held to one day and one nomination, and that the rest of the record from this era is comparatively thin. We report it as it stands.
